claims.excerpt: Two Pollutants, Two Tracks in the Acid Rain Program
claims.claim: The Acid Rain Program addressed sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides on distinct regulatory tracks.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: EPA’s Acid Rain Program addresses sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides from the power sector under Title IV. The sulfur dioxide mechanism applies an aggregate cap and allows trading; one allowance covers one ton. ... The nitrogen oxides component was rate-based for certain coal-fired units, began in 1996 and did not introduce a cap or allowance trading.
claims.narrative: The reader should understand the difference between these two pollutant-specific tracks, rather than assume the program applied one rule to both.
claims.explanation: The source describes different mechanisms and timelines for the two pollutants.
claims.materiality: Material to the piece’s central framing; the distinction is supported.
